name: awards
description: A row of award, rating and compliance badges. Logos only, no copy. Sits between major sections as a trust strip.

items.description: Badges. Each entry: `image` (URL, required), `alt` (required), optional `url` to link the badge.

title.description: Visually-hidden heading naming the group, for screen readers.

layout.description: wrap: centred rows that wrap (homepage). row: one centred row of 100px badges (product pages). spread: one row edge to edge (industry hubs).

reveal.description: Stagger the badges in on scroll.
